## About
Otto Works Collision Center is a family owned shop on E Apache Trail in Apache Junction, owned and run by Brandon and Crissie Lindquist. We serve drivers across the East Valley, including Apache Junction, Mesa, Gold Canyon, Queen Creek, Globe and Florence Junction.
We know an accident is stressful, and the repair can be too. So we explain what we're doing, keep you updated while your vehicle is here, and try to make the whole process as easy on you as we can.
We handle major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles, from frame straightening and paint to hail damage and mechanical work. Our body and paint work is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

## Services
- Frame straightening: Frame work using multiple pulling systems and the Genesis Computerized Laser Measuring System.
- Complete painting: Full paint jobs done in our shop.
- Computerized paint matching: Paint matched and mixed by computer so the color blends in.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents pulled out without repainting when the damage allows it.
- Hail and sand damage repair: Repair for the hail and sand damage that comes with living in the desert.
- Fiberglass repair: Repairs on fiberglass body parts.
- Suspension and mechanical work: Suspension and mechanical repairs done alongside your body work.
- Diagnostics for dash lights: We'll find out why that warning light came on.
- Photo estimating: Send us photos of the damage to get started on an estimate.
- Pick up and delivery: Ask about having your vehicle, or you, picked up and dropped off.

## FAQ
Q: Can I choose where my car gets repaired?
A: Yes. You have the right to have your vehicle repaired at the shop of your choice, regardless of who you are insured by.

Q: Do I need to get several estimates?
A: No. By law you only need one repair estimate.

Q: What warranty comes with the repair?
A: Our body and paint work carries a Limited Lifetime Warranty. Parts are covered by the manufacturer for 12 months or 12,000 miles.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks, RV's and motorcycles, foreign and domestic. One reviewer recommends us for classic cars too.

Q: Who do I call for a tow?
A: Our site points customers to Delta Towing.
